# Painted Porch Strategies

> Organizational shift strategy and change origination for leaders ready to architect extraordinary outcomes.

Painted Porch Strategies partners with organizations at the moment of strategic authorship—before decisions are made and before initiatives are scoped. The P.A.T.H. is the four stages of change (Prepare, Align, Take Off, Habits), and three ShIFts partner on them: Envision ShIFt (the Epic ShIFt Organizational Appraisal) at Prepare, Architect ShIFt at Align, and Embody ShIFt from Take Off through Habits. Every engagement begins with a Clarity Call. Each reads an organization through The Painted Porch Pillars: Cultural Cornerstone, Operational Frame, and Living Ecosystem. Individuals and teams also find workshops, masterclasses, mini courses, labs and assessments on the P.A.T.H.way pages.

## Pages

- [/](/): Home — build an organization that can do epic shIFt; the P.A.T.H. and the three ShIFts.

- [/envision-shift](/envision-shift): Envision ShIFt — the Epic ShIFt Organizational Appraisal, an interview-led organizational 360 (six interviews, executives to the frontline) that produces the P.A.T.H. Compass. Begins with a Clarity Call.
- [/architect-shift](/architect-shift): Architect ShIFt — an executive authorship intensive and a 90-day pillar-fortification sprint, after the appraisal.
- [/embody-shift](/embody-shift): Embody ShIFt — ongoing advisory from Take Off through Habits.
